definitions.full: H6762. Tsela צֵלַע proper name, of a location in Benjamin Josh 18:28 , A ᵐ5 L Σελα [( ε ) λαφ ]; burial-place of Saul 2Sam 21:14 ( צֵלָֹע ), ἐν τῇ πλευρᾷ ; possinly = Tel Amarna Zilu , so Zim ZA vi. 258 Jastr JBL xi (1892), 105 (Wkl, however, thinks of סלע ).

occurrences.englishText: Zelah, Eleph, the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem), Gibeath, and Kiriath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.

They buried the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son in the country of Benjamin in Zela, in the tomb of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. After that, God answered prayer for the land.
